proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11012 *lāḍa gives Kashmiri lāra husband/lörī wife, Kangri lāṛī wife and Western Pahari laṛɔ bridegroom/laṛi bride. These regional marital terms match that family, retaining each survey sense. Exact survey form ləɽi is preserved.
